D01.summary: Concrete targets, counts and minima for the 139 slots the design left open (library v2: the v1 slots plus the R1 additions).
D01.title: Parameters of the 139 proposed variants

D02.summary: F0 imperative, F1 requirement; A's strings are v8.1 A frames 0/1, B's are historical B wordings 1/0; the carried DCI-1 prompt template with one numbered instruction.
D02.title: The two wording frames and the prompt

D03.summary: Historical alpha-run words for every family; certified sentence segmentation; A folded per word (differs from historical S0 only on U+0130).
D03.title: Text semantics

D04.summary: Compliant = PASS on a non-empty, untruncated, non-vacuous answer. A completed blank generation (the seam's CHANNEL_INVALID under NO_THINKING) is an EMPTY answer: in n, never compliant, not regenerated. A technical failure is never evidence and stays open for resume, up to max_technical_attempts per row. Literal passes and the reason a pass is excluded are recorded.
D04.title: Outcomes, compliance and vacuity

D05.summary: The 144 topics of bank v3, written fresh for v2.1 (distinct from bank v1 with its 480 reserved topics, and from bank v2, whose topics the v2 run of 2026-10-26 measured), in 12 areas, split by a fixed seed into T1 (48 topics, Stage A screening; one response per stand-alone and task-only cell) and T2 (96 topics, Stage C membership); none reserved. Screened against the historical banks and every earlier Batch 1 bank, by word overlap and a blind semantic review; bank v1's 480 reserved topics stay unused, for the confirmatory study.
D05.title: Topic bank v3 and its split

D06.summary: Stage A measures every reference, A x 4/5/6, B 8 and 10 and the task alone on T1. Stage B draws each T1 cell from its Beta posterior and applies D08-D11 with the fixed-A and fixed-B gates. Early stop: if P(feasible) < forecast_min_feasible for any one contrast, the whole run stops before T2 (no T2 data for any contrast) and the verdict names the reason: EARLY_STOP_LIBRARY_LIMITED (the library cannot reach the target; R9 applies), EARLY_STOP_FIXED_A_OR_B (the fixed A or B fails its own gate), or EARLY_STOP_JOINT. Otherwise Stage C measures every reference in the library, plus A x 6, B 8 and 10 and the task alone, one response per T2 topic. T2 alone decides eligibility, matching and membership; T1 never enters them. No C' top-up. Both stages must be complete (no partial-completion rule). Accounting: max_total_rows bounds every generation attempt in the pilot root, evidence and technical retries alike, in Stages A and C. The Stage C plan is refused if Stage A plus the plan does not fit, and every execute or resume is refused if the attempts already made plus the rows it would request exceed it; retries (at most max_technical_attempts per row) can use only the headroom left by the plan. The smoke test (its own root, at most 96 rows) is outside the bound and reported separately.
D06.title: Stages A-D, forecast, early stop and what T2 measures

D07.summary: B is fixed (R4), not selected. On T2 each limit must be informative (B-only compliance inside b_informative_band) in >= b_min_informative_model_frames model-frames, or the verdict is B_NOT_INFORMATIVE.
D07.title: B fixed at 8 and 10, checked on T2

D08.summary: A is fixed (R3), not selected; A x 4 and x 5 are measured on T1 as diagnostics only. On T2, A must be informative (p_A inside a_headroom_band) in >= a_min_informative_model_frames model-frames across >= a_min_informative_models models, or the verdict is A_NOT_ADMISSIBLE. Uninformative-A configurations never count toward feasibility; a G1 count below the target is flagged A_COVERAGE_INADEQUATE.
D08.title: A fixed at however x 6, checked on T2

D09.summary: Point estimate >= 20% in at least one model-frame, on the T2 responses of that cell only; 10% extension reported separately. The OR over eight cells admits candidates whose true rate is below 20% (disclosed).
D09.title: Eligibility operationalisation

D10.summary: |p_X - p_A| <= 0.10 per model-frame on raw T2 compliance, in exact arithmetic (primary, deciding). Reported beside it, never deciding (R5): posterior P(match) per reference and model-frame, and coverage under +/-0.15, +/-0.20, confident matching (Newcombe interval inside +/-0.10) and iota matching.
D10.title: Matching operationalisation

D11.summary: Design minima for G1 (3 distinct words), P1 (G2 adds 2) and P2 (G3 adds 2 other-object references). P3 is stricter than the design (the researcher's decision of 2026-10-25): G5 adds 3 other-operation references, not 2, and |G3| >= p3_min_g3 (3). Feasibility needs 12 of 16 configurations, 3 models and both B limits (unchanged). Pools are eligible references logically compatible with the configuration's B limit. Stage B's forecast uses exactly these rules.
D11.title: Coverage requirements

D12.summary: Historical four-model panel and decoding; cap 512 tokens, with any cell truncating above truncation_review_share listed for review; the seed derivation; the vLLM seam source; Python 3.12 for the orchestrator and the vLLM backend (the CUDA vllm 0.15.1 wheel is cp38-abi3; 3.12 is vLLM's Docker default and native on GPU Base 24.04); the execution requirements (vllm 0.15.1, torch 2.9.1+cu129, 2x H100 SXM, driver >= 575.51.03), one worker per GPU, TP as configured. The execution environment is attested on the host, checked against the requirements and bound by Freeze 1; a bounded, authorised smoke test (never evidence) measures load time, throughput and truncation first.
D12.title: Model panel, decoding, cap, seeds and backend

D13.summary: Object types as in v1 plus library v2's (numerals, sentence and paragraph ladders, positional); weights equal over operations, then object types, then, inside an exact-word-count group, equal over target words and then over a word's count variants (R10).
D13.title: Object types and hierarchical weights

D14.summary: Topic-cluster bootstrap on T2: inclusion frequency, FEASIBLE share, borderline matches, feasibility on majority-stable members; a near-threshold record; a truncation review of cells above truncation_review_share with >= truncation_review_min_rows truncated rows (R11). Also reported: T1-versus-T2 agreement (eligibility, matching, forecast against verdict). Review rule (the researcher's of 2026-10-25, DECISIONS_2026-10-25.md): every Freeze 2 flag blocks Batch 2 until the researcher reviews it, including FEASIBILITY_UNSTABLE and any truncation-review cell; only MEMBERSHIP_UNSTABLE proceeds, with disclosure. Nothing is auto-corrected and no threshold is changed in response to a result.
D14.title: Membership-stability diagnostics, their review, and T1-T2 agreement
